Join the thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers behind tomorrow's technology.

As a Staff Engineer Analog Design in our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life.

In this role, you will contribute to the development of highly integrated semiconductor solutions that enable efficient power conversion, intelligent energy management, and sustainable technologies. To do so, you will collaborate closely with our key development (R&D) experts

Your profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

 * A degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Physics or a related field
 * Typically 7+ years of hands-on experience in power electronics design, development, and testing with a strong focus on DC-DC converter topologies, PFC, and SMPS, ideally including OBC applications

 * Strong technical leadership skills with the ability to challenge ideas constructively, balance risks and opportunities, and drive decisions collaboratively in a global organization

• Coordinate vehicle administration and upkeep, including servicing, registration, insurance, cleaning, and fuel or charging arrangements.

Office Management
